Episode-level counterfactual analysis — running complete episodes under pure-internal and pure-deterministic strategies — overcomes this circularity and reveals the death-avoidance mechanism. The resulting labels train a lightweight router (Qwen3-1.7B) that serves as a **diagnostic probe** for LLM failure modes.
